facts.fact: The current plan page identifies the Enfield Local Plan as being at Regulation 24 Examination in Public.
The page lists a 29 June council response to the Inspector’s post-hearing letter.
The page lists the Inspector’s post-hearing letter IN14 dated 15 June.
Focused hearing sessions were held on 18 and 19 March.
The 19 March hearing agenda included Allocation RUR.01 and Allocation URB.01.
On 12 February the Inspector indicated that a short and focused further hearing series was necessary.
On 4 February the council published its response to the Inspector’s 12 December 2025 letter.
Stage 2 hearings on 1 and 2 July covered Crews Hill matters.
The 3 July Stage 2 hearing covered RUR.01, RUR.05, RUR.03 and RUR.04.
Stage 3 included a 22 October session on Homes for All.
Stage 3 included a 23 October session on Economy policies.
Stage 3 included a 28 October session on Transport and Culture policies.
Stage 3 included a 29 October session on Design policies.
Stage 3 included a 30 October session on Tall Buildings.
Stage 3 included an 11 November session on Climate Change.
The submitted plan is examined against the December 2023 National Planning Policy Framework.
Full Council approved Regulation 19 publication on 19 March 2024.
The Regulation 19 plan was published for a minimum six-week consultation period.
The Planning Inspectorate performs an independent soundness and legal-compliance examination before adoption.
Examination events and hearing references are temporal/process evidence and are not candidate polygon membership.
